interpretation: 현재 서울 페르소나에 2021년 정책과 코로나 환경을 적용한 가상실험
persona_attributes: keep current structural attributes; do not re-age to 2021
announcement_handling: Fork the same warmed state before the 8/30 detailed announcement; awareness and receipt are separate events. This does not reconstruct all earlier 2021 policy news.
primary_contrast: covid_with_grant minus covid_no_grant, paired by agent and simulation day; repeat across seeds

eligibility.preferred: household insurance and asset rules when supported by input data
eligibility.fallback: explicitly synthetic household/entitlement manifest calibrated to public Seoul aggregates; never relabel spending rank as observed insurance premium

seoul_aggregate_benchmark.use: aggregate approximation and sensitivity only; published after treatment begins, never an agent prompt fact

eligibility.sensitivity: vary allocation mechanism and coverage around the approximate Seoul benchmark; report rather than optimize against consumption outcomes

measurements: grant redemption distinct from incremental consumption
freeze_before_run: agent ID set and population weights
code paths and hashes including deployed files
policy IDs active in each arm
readiness_requirements: dated environment reaches Stage1/Stage2/Night for both arms
DB readback of actual exposed agents
small end-to-end smoke run with nonzero eligible receipts and audited transactions
